## Motivation

With an a2a backend (for example `--moe-a2a-backend deepep`), a server started with `--init-expert-location` set to a `physical_to_logical_map` in which one EP rank holds two replicas of the same logical expert never loads the second replica. A rank that holds no replica of that expert can still dispatch tokens to that slot, so those tokens go through an expert whose weights were never written. There is no error; the outputs just change. Reloading the weights through the same loader (for example with `update_weights_from_disk`) skips the same slots.

Such layouts come out of EPLB: the packing step can put two replicas of a hot expert on one GPU (deepseek-ai/EPLB#22), and SGLang's copy of the algorithm does too. Passing a saved, rebalanced layout back through `--init-expert-location` therefore hits this. In two layouts that we saved from Qwen3-30B-A3B servers (EP2, 2 redundant experts) after online rebalancing, 16 and 23 of the 48 layers had such a pair.

Where it happens (main @ 78185f4b):

1. [`_compute_logical_to_all_physical_map`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/78185f4b3f565cbe0fec20d71bb5deb372428e80/python/sglang/srt/eplb/expert_location.py#L557-L591): with an a2a backend, each rank replaces every logical expert's candidate list with [`_find_nearest_expert`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/78185f4b3f565cbe0fec20d71bb5deb372428e80/python/sglang/srt/eplb/expert_location.py#L699-L737) (#10874). A rank that holds replicas keeps only its first local one. A rank that holds none keeps the full list (on one node).
2. [`FusedMoE.weight_loader`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/78185f4b3f565cbe0fec20d71bb5deb372428e80/python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/fused_moe_triton/layer.py#L1099-L1104) writes a checkpoint expert into the slots that `logical_to_all_physical()` returns, which is this narrowed list, and [`_weight_loader_physical`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/78185f4b3f565cbe0fec20d71bb5deb372428e80/python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/fused_moe_triton/layer.py#L1124-L1127) keeps the local ones. The rank that holds both replicas writes only the first. For unquantized weights the second one stays [`torch.empty`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/78185f4b3f565cbe0fec20d71bb5deb372428e80/python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/unquant.py#L787-L789).
3. [The static dispatch table](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/78185f4b3f565cbe0fec20d71bb5deb372428e80/python/sglang/srt/eplb/expert_location.py#L612-L672) gives a rank without a local replica a [`_fair_choices`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/78185f4b3f565cbe0fec20d71bb5deb372428e80/python/sglang/srt/eplb/expert_location.py#L662-L667) pick among all replicas, which can be the unloaded one. `static` is [the default with an a2a backend](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/78185f4b3f565cbe0fec20d71bb5deb372428e80/python/sglang/srt/arg_groups/parallel_hook.py#L751-L764); with `--ep-dispatch-algorithm dynamic`, [the same list is sampled per token](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/78185f4b3f565cbe0fec20d71bb5deb372428e80/python/sglang/srt/eplb/expert_location_dispatch.py#L114-L153).

The narrowing has left rows unloaded before: #12866 removed it to fix NaN NVFP4 input scales, and #13162 / #13484 restored it with a separate path for those global scale parameters (`require_global_experts`). That relies on the other unloaded rows never being dispatched to, and a second replica on the same rank breaks it. #32962 skipped the narrowing when there is no a2a backend; the a2a path is unchanged.

## Modifications

- `ExpertLocationMetadata.logical_to_all_physical()` (`eplb/expert_location.py`): for a routed expert, it now returns every physical slot that `physical_to_logical_map` assigns to the expert, on all ranks, instead of reading the per-rank dispatch list `logical_to_all_physical_map`.
  - The draft-layer fallback and the `require_global_experts` branch are unchanged. They only read the map's shape, and `logical_to_all_physical_map` is padded to the number of physical slots, so both maps give the same values.
  - For a layer in the map and without `require_global_experts`, the lookup rejects out-of-range logical expert ids with `IndexError`, including negative ids, which used to index from the end. The draft-layer and global-scale branches keep their existing conventions.
  - The dispatch fields (`logical_to_all_physical_map`, `logical_to_rank_dispatch_physical_map`) are not touched, so the nearest-replica dispatch from #10874 stays as it is.
- `FusedMoE._local_routed_expert_ids()` (`layers/moe/fused_moe_triton/layer.py`, new) keeps the slots in this rank's routed range. `FusedMoE.weight_loader` applies it to a routed expert's slots (not with `require_global_experts`) before `_weight_loader_physical` maps them to local ids.
  - This is needed because the list now also holds other ranks' slots. After an elastic EP scale-up, a new rank's routed slot can lie past the `_num_global_routed` that an existing rank's layer set at startup, and `_map_global_expert_id_to_local_expert_id` maps such a slot onto that rank's fused shared expert.
  - From reading the code and a CPU test with a stand-in layer, this already happens on main for a rank that holds no replica of the expert, because its narrowed list is the full list. The filter covers that case too.
- `moe_wna16._local_expert_ids` (`layers/quantization/moe_wna16.py`) writes qzeros outside the layer's loader, so it applies the same filter to routed experts. A fused shared expert's id, which the draft-layer fallback returns, is not filtered.
- The third caller, `elastic_ep/expert_backup_client.py`, already keeps only its own range and is unchanged.
- New CPU test file `test/registered/unit/eplb/test_expert_location_weight_loading.py` (`base-a-test-cpu`, 8 tests). It is a new file because it drives the real `FusedMoE` and `moe_wna16` loaders through a stand-in layer, unlike the existing dispatch-table tests. The tests check that:
  - the lookup returns exactly each expert's slots: a same-rank pair, a two-node layout where a rank narrows to a same-node replica, random EP4 layouts, with and without an a2a backend;
  - the real `FusedMoE.weight_loader` and `_weight_loader_physical` fill every local slot with its own expert (the same layouts, random EP2 and EP4); the stand-in layer records the writes instead of copying tensors;
  - every entry of each rank's static dispatch table points at a slot that holds that expert;
  - after an EP 2 -> 4 scale-up, loading routed experts on the existing ranks keeps their fused shared slot;
  - a param with `_sglang_require_global_experts` still gets every slot, on every rank (the new filter does not apply to it);
  - `moe_wna16` picks the right qzeros slots: a second replica, scale-up on ranks 0 and 1, a draft layer with a fused shared expert;
  - the dispatch candidates are unchanged;
  - the draft-layer fallback and the global-scale branch keep their conventions, and out-of-range and negative ids raise.

Alternatives considered:

- Keep every local replica when narrowing. This fixes loading but changes dispatch: `dynamic` gets more candidates, and the static table draws its random picks in a different order.
- Change only dispatch, so that no rank picks an unloaded replica. After an online rebalance the lists are full again, and a slot that keeps the same expert is not copied (`update_expert_weights_single_layer` treats it as unchanged), so a never-written slot can still be picked.
- Copy the first local replica into the others after loading. That has to cover every load path and every parameter, including quantization scales.

## Accuracy Tests

**CPU repro** (script and full output below). EP2, 4 logical experts + 2 redundant, rank 1 holds both replicas of expert 3 (slots 3 and 4), rank 0 holds none.

- On main @ 78185f4b, rank 1 never writes slot 4. Rank 0's static table sends expert 3 to slot 4 in 1 of 8 layers, and with `dynamic`, 4047 of rank 0's 8000 tokens for expert 3 go there.
- With this PR, rank 1 writes slots 3, 4 and 5. Both ranks' static picks for expert 3 are the same as on main, layer by layer; this PR does not touch the dispatch tables.

**CPU tests**

- The new file: 8 passed, 42 subtests.
- Together with the existing `test/registered/unit/eplb/`, `test/registered/unit/model_loader/test_presharded_loader.py`, `test/registered/unit/model_loader/test_modelopt_loader.py` and `test/registered/unit/layers/quantization/test_moe_wna16_ep_shard.py`: 123 passed, 2 skipped (both need CUDA), 88 subtests passed.
- With the fix reverted in place (the old lookup, a filter that keeps every id, the old `moe_wna16` code), 6 of the 8 new tests fail. Each of these partial changes makes at least one new test fail:
  - reverting only the lookup;
  - making only the new filter keep every id;
  - reverting only the `moe_wna16` change;
  - filtering shared ids in `moe_wna16` too;
  - applying the filter to `require_global_experts` params too;
  - dropping the lower bound of the id check.
- Lint with the versions pinned in `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, plus `check_registered_tests`: clean.

**GPU.** We ran this change once, on an earlier `main`, with the two saved layouts; this was not a GPU run of 78185f4b itself. That tree also had the changes of #45341, which are inactive here because the weight cache is off.

- Model and flags: Qwen3-30B-A3B (BF16) with `--tp 2 --ep-size 2 --enable-eplb --ep-num-redundant-experts 2 --random-seed 42 --moe-a2a-backend deepep --deepep-mode normal --moe-runner-backend deep_gemm --deepep-dispatcher-output-dtype bf16 --max-running-requests 128 --mem-fraction-static 0.6 --disable-radix-cache --eplb-rebalance-num-iterations 1000000000 --expert-distribution-recorder-buffer-size 1000` (no rebalance during the test), plus `--init-expert-location` set to one of the two saved layouts above.
- Controls, in the same run: the same model, flags, saved layouts and disk-loading path, without this change. Their trees also had inactive weight-cache changes.
- After loading, we hashed every tensor on every rank, slot by slot for the expert tensors.
- A slot counts as an expert only if its hashes equal those of an expert in a server that used the default layout and never rebalanced.
- The reference is a server that routes with the same layout and whose 6240 expert slots all hold the expert the layout puts there. It received its weights through the weight cache from a server that had rebalanced into this layout (#45341).
- Greedy outputs: 8 fixed prompts x 32 tokens.

| | layout 1 | layout 2 |
|---|---|---|
| layers with two replicas of an expert on one rank (of 48) | 16 | 23 |
| slots that hold such a second replica (of 6240) | 19 | 27 |
| without this change: slots that hold no expert | 19, exactly those | 27, exactly those |
| without this change: expert slots equal to the reference | 6221 | 6213 |
| with this change: expert slots equal to the reference | 6240 | 6240 |
| greedy outputs equal to the reference, without / with this change | 7/8 / 8/8 | 5/8 / 8/8 |

All non-expert tensors were byte-identical to the reference on both ranks, in all four servers.

GSM8K (5-shot, all 1319 questions, 128 at a time) was recorded for context and was not a criterion. Correct answers: 1204 and 1210 without this change, 1205 and 1193 with it. Two passes of the never-rebalanced server on the same setup differed by 7 and by 9.

Not tested on GPU:
- quantized checkpoints (the `moe_wna16` path);
- elastic EP scale-up;
- `dynamic` dispatch;
- online rebalancing after startup, and weight updates after it;
- other models, EP > 2, more than one node;
- a repeat of this run.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not measured. Only weight loading changes: the lookup compares one row of `physical_to_logical_map` per call instead of indexing the per-rank list, and a rank that holds two replicas of an expert now writes that expert twice. Dispatch and forward passes are unchanged.

## Related

- #10874: the per-rank narrowing.
- The earlier fix for unloaded rows of global scale parameters: #12866, #13162, #13348 (reverted #13162 after loading hangs), #13484 (reintroduced it with a race fix).
- #32962: no narrowing without an a2a backend.
- Open #45282 and #37923 also edit `eplb/expert_location.py`, in other functions.
- deepseek-ai/EPLB#22: the algorithm can put duplicate replicas on one GPU. deepseek-ai/EPLB#27 and deepseek-ai/EPLB#28 try to avoid that where possible; layouts that already exist are not changed.
- Open #45322 adds an `elif` right before the `logical_to_all_physical()` call in `FusedMoE.weight_loader`. Whichever lands second may need a small rebase.
- Different from #39580 and #18213, which are about wrong output after rebalancing without an a2a backend.

```python
"""CPU-only repro: with an a2a backend (e.g. --moe-a2a-backend deepep) and an
--init-expert-location physical_to_logical_map that puts two replicas of one
logical expert on the same EP rank, the second replica is never loaded, while
another rank's static dispatch table can still route tokens to it.

It calls the real SGLang code; no GPU, model or server is needed:
  compute_initial_expert_location_metadata    what each rank builds from --init-expert-location
  ExpertLocationMetadata.logical_to_all_physical  the slots FusedMoE.weight_loader writes
  topk_ids_logical_to_physical                the physical slot a token is dispatched to

Usage: PYTHONPATH=<sglang checkout>/python python repro_same_rank_replica.py [--layers N]
Exit code: 1 if a rank dispatches to a slot its owner never loads, else 0.
"""

import argparse
import json
import sys
from unittest import mock

import torch

from sglang.srt.eplb import expert_location as el
from sglang.srt.eplb.expert_location_dispatch import (
    ExpertLocationDispatchInfo,
    topk_ids_logical_to_physical,
)
from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context

EP_SIZE = 2
NUM_LOGICAL = 4
NUM_REDUNDANT = 2
NUM_PHYSICAL = NUM_LOGICAL + NUM_REDUNDANT  # 6 slots: rank 0 = 0..2, rank 1 = 3..5
SLOTS_PER_RANK = NUM_PHYSICAL // EP_SIZE
NUM_LAYERS = 8  # --layers
HOT = 3
# Same row in every layer: logical expert 3 has two replicas, both on rank 1
# (slots 3 and 4); rank 0 has no replica of it.
ROW = [0, 1, 2, 3, 3, 0]


def owner(slot):
    return slot // SLOTS_PER_RANK


def build_rank(rank, a2a_backend, dispatch_algorithm, num_tokens=1):
    """Return what one EP rank loads and where it dispatches, per layer."""
    shape = el.ModelConfigForExpertLocation(
        num_layers=NUM_LAYERS, num_logical_experts=NUM_LOGICAL
    )
    overrides = dict(
        device="cpu",
        ep_size=EP_SIZE,
        nnodes=1,
        moe_a2a_backend=a2a_backend,
        ep_dispatch_algorithm=dispatch_algorithm,
        ep_num_redundant_experts=NUM_REDUNDANT,
        init_expert_location=json.dumps(
            {"physical_to_logical_map": [ROW] * NUM_LAYERS}
        ),
    )
    # No model is loaded, so only the layer / expert counts come from the patch.
    with get_context().override_server_args(**overrides), mock.patch.object(
        el.ModelConfigForExpertLocation,
        "from_model_config",
        staticmethod(lambda model_config: shape),
    ):
        # ModelRunner.maybe_init_expert_location_metadata does this on every rank
        # before load_model(). With static dispatch it also builds this rank's
        # logical_to_rank_dispatch_physical_map (a seeded random pick, seed 42).
        metadata = el.compute_initial_expert_location_metadata(
            model_config=None, moe_ep_rank=rank
        )
        el.set_global_expert_location_metadata(metadata, allow_overwrite=True)
        loaded, dispatch = [], []
        for layer in range(NUM_LAYERS):
            # FusedMoE.weight_loader: for checkpoint expert e, write every slot in
            # logical_to_all_physical(layer, e) that lives on this rank.
            loaded.append(
                sorted(
                    slot
                    for e in range(NUM_LOGICAL)
                    for slot in metadata.logical_to_all_physical(layer, e)
                    if owner(slot) == rank
                )
            )
            info = ExpertLocationDispatchInfo.init_new(layer_id=layer)
            topk_ids = torch.full((num_tokens, 1), HOT, dtype=torch.int64)
            dispatch.append(topk_ids_logical_to_physical(topk_ids, info).view(-1))
        candidates = metadata.logical_to_all_physical(0, HOT)
    return loaded, dispatch, candidates


def run(a2a_backend, dispatch_algorithm, num_tokens=1):
    ranks = [
        build_rank(r, a2a_backend, dispatch_algorithm, num_tokens)
        for r in range(EP_SIZE)
    ]
    print(
        f"\n== --moe-a2a-backend {a2a_backend} "
        f"--ep-dispatch-algorithm {dispatch_algorithm} =="
    )
    for r, (loaded, _, candidates) in enumerate(ranks):
        never = sorted(
            set(range(r * SLOTS_PER_RANK, (r + 1) * SLOTS_PER_RANK)) - set(loaded[0])
        )
        print(
            f"rank {r}: weight loader writes slots {loaded[0]}, never writes {never}; "
            f"logical_to_all_physical(layer, {HOT}) = {candidates}"
        )
    bad_layers = set()
    for r, (_, dispatch, _) in enumerate(ranks):
        hits = {}  # layer -> tokens sent to a slot its owner never loaded
        for layer, slots in enumerate(dispatch):
            missing = [
                int(s) for s in slots if int(s) not in ranks[owner(int(s))][0][layer]
            ]
            if missing:
                hits[layer] = missing
        bad_layers |= set(hits)
        slots_hit = sorted({s for m in hits.values() for s in m})
        if num_tokens == 1:
            picks = [int(d[0]) for d in dispatch]
            print(
                f"rank {r}: logical {HOT} is dispatched to slot, per layer: {picks}"
                + (
                    f"\n        -> never-loaded slot {slots_hit} in layers {sorted(hits)}"
                    if hits
                    else ""
                )
            )
        else:
            n = sum(len(m) for m in hits.values())
            print(
                f"rank {r}: {n}/{num_tokens * NUM_LAYERS} tokens of logical {HOT} go to "
                f"never-loaded slot(s) {slots_hit} ({len(hits)}/{NUM_LAYERS} layers)"
            )
    return len(bad_layers)


def main():
    global NUM_LAYERS
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    parser.add_argument("--layers", type=int, default=NUM_LAYERS)
    NUM_LAYERS = parser.parse_args().layers
    print(
        f"EP size {EP_SIZE}, {NUM_LOGICAL} logical experts + {NUM_REDUNDANT} redundant = "
        f"{NUM_PHYSICAL} slots ({SLOTS_PER_RANK} per rank), {NUM_LAYERS} layers"
    )
    print(
        f"--init-expert-location row in every layer: rank 0 slots 0-2 = {ROW[:3]}, "
        f"rank 1 slots 3-5 = {ROW[3:]}"
    )
    bad_static = run("deepep", "static")
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    bad_dynamic = run("deepep", "dynamic", num_tokens=1000)
    bad_control = run("none", "dynamic", num_tokens=1000)
    print()
    print(f"layers that route to a never-loaded slot (of {NUM_LAYERS}):")
    print(f"  deepep + static (default with an a2a backend): {bad_static}")
    print(f"  deepep + dynamic: {bad_dynamic}")
    print(f"  control, no a2a backend: {bad_control}")
    reproduced = bad_static > 0 or bad_dynamic > 0
    print("RESULT:", "REPRODUCED" if reproduced else "NOT_REPRODUCED")
    return 1 if reproduced else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

detail.body:
## Motivation

With an a2a backend (for example `--moe-a2a-backend deepep`), a server started with `--init-expert-location` set to a `physical_to_logical_map` in which one EP rank holds two replicas of the same logical expert never loads the second replica. A rank that holds no replica of that expert can still dispatch tokens to that slot, so those tokens go through an expert whose weights were never written. There is no error; the outputs just change. Reloading the weights through the same loader (for example with `update_weights_from_disk`) skips the same slots.

Such layouts come out of EPLB: the packing step can put two replicas of a hot expert on one GPU (deepseek-ai/EPLB#22), and SGLang's copy of the algorithm does too. Passing a saved, rebalanced layout back through `--init-expert-location` therefore hits this. In two layouts that we saved from Qwen3-30B-A3B servers (EP2, 2 redundant experts) after online rebalancing, 16 and 23 of the 48 layers had such a pair.

Where it happens (main @ 78185f4b):

1. [`_compute_logical_to_all_physical_map`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/78185f4b3f565cbe0fec20d71bb5deb372428e80/python/sglang/srt/eplb/expert_location.py#L557-L591): with an a2a backend, each rank replaces every logical expert's candidate list with [`_find_nearest_expert`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/78185f4b3f565cbe0fec20d71bb5deb372428e80/python/sglang/srt/eplb/expert_location.py#L699-L737) (#10874). A rank that holds replicas keeps only its first local one. A rank that holds none keeps the full list (on one node).
2. [`FusedMoE.weight_loader`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/78185f4b3f565cbe0fec20d71bb5deb372428e80/python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/fused_moe_triton/layer.py#L1099-L1104) writes a checkpoint expert into the slots that `logical_to_all_physical()` returns, which is this narrowed list, and [`_weight_loader_physical`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/78185f4b3f565cbe0fec20d71bb5deb372428e80/python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/fused_moe_triton/layer.py#L1124-L1127) keeps the local ones. The rank that holds both replicas writes only the first. For unquantized weights the second one stays [`torch.empty`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/78185f4b3f565cbe0fec20d71bb5deb372428e80/python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/unquant.py#L787-L789).
3. [The static dispatch table](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/78185f4b3f565cbe0fec20d71bb5deb372428e80/python/sglang/srt/eplb/expert_location.py#L612-L672) gives a rank without a local replica a [`_fair_choices`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/78185f4b3f565cbe0fec20d71bb5deb372428e80/python/sglang/srt/eplb/expert_location.py#L662-L667) pick among all replicas, which can be the unloaded one. `static` is [the default with an a2a backend](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/78185f4b3f565cbe0fec20d71bb5deb372428e80/python/sglang/srt/arg_groups/parallel_hook.py#L751-L764); with `--ep-dispatch-algorithm dynamic`, [the same list is sampled per token](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/78185f4b3f565cbe0fec20d71bb5deb372428e80/python/sglang/srt/eplb/expert_location_dispatch.py#L114-L153).

The narrowing has left rows unloaded before: #12866 removed it to fix NaN NVFP4 input scales, and #13162 / #13484 restored it with a separate path for those global scale parameters (`require_global_experts`). That relies on the other unloaded rows never being dispatched to, and a second replica on the same rank breaks it. #32962 skipped the narrowing when there is no a2a backend; the a2a path is unchanged.

## Modifications

- `ExpertLocationMetadata.logical_to_all_physical()` (`eplb/expert_location.py`): for a routed expert, it now returns every physical slot that `physical_to_logical_map` assigns to the expert, on all ranks, instead of reading the per-rank dispatch list `logical_to_all_physical_map`.
  - The draft-layer fallback and the `require_global_experts` branch are unchanged. They only read the map's shape, and `logical_to_all_physical_map` is padded to the number of physical slots, so both maps give the same values.
  - For a layer in the map and without `require_global_experts`, the lookup rejects out-of-range logical expert ids with `IndexError`, including negative ids, which used to index from the end. The draft-layer and global-scale branches keep their existing conventions.
  - The dispatch fields (`logical_to_all_physical_map`, `logical_to_rank_dispatch_physical_map`) are not touched, so the nearest-replica dispatch from #10874 stays as it is.
- `FusedMoE._local_routed_expert_ids()` (`layers/moe/fused_moe_triton/layer.py`, new) keeps the slots in this rank's routed range. `FusedMoE.weight_loader` applies it to a routed expert's slots (not with `require_global_experts`) before `_weight_loader_physical` maps them to local ids.
  - This is needed because the list now also holds other ranks' slots. After an elastic EP scale-up, a new rank's routed slot can lie past the `_num_global_routed` that an existing rank's layer set at startup, and `_map_global_expert_id_to_local_expert_id` maps such a slot onto that rank's fused shared expert.
  - From reading the code and a CPU test with a stand-in layer, this already happens on main for a rank that holds no replica of the expert, because its narrowed list is the full list. The filter covers that case too.
- `moe_wna16._local_expert_ids` (`layers/quantization/moe_wna16.py`) writes qzeros outside the layer's loader, so it applies the same filter to routed experts. A fused shared expert's id, which the draft-layer fallback returns, is not filtered.
- The third caller, `elastic_ep/expert_backup_client.py`, already keeps only its own range and is unchanged.
- New CPU test file `test/registered/unit/eplb/test_expert_location_weight_loading.py` (`base-a-test-cpu`, 8 tests). It is a new file because it drives the real `FusedMoE` and `moe_wna16` loaders through a stand-in layer, unlike the existing dispatch-table tests. The tests check that:
  - the lookup returns exactly each expert's slots: a same-rank pair, a two-node layout where a rank narrows to a same-node replica, random EP4 layouts, with and without an a2a backend;
  - the real `FusedMoE.weight_loader` and `_weight_loader_physical` fill every local slot with its own expert (the same layouts, random EP2 and EP4); the stand-in layer records the writes instead of copying tensors;
  - every entry of each rank's static dispatch table points at a slot that holds that expert;
  - after an EP 2 -> 4 scale-up, loading routed experts on the existing ranks keeps their fused shared slot;
  - a param with `_sglang_require_global_experts` still gets every slot, on every rank (the new filter does not apply to it);
  - `moe_wna16` picks the right qzeros slots: a second replica, scale-up on ranks 0 and 1, a draft layer with a fused shared expert;
  - the dispatch candidates are unchanged;
  - the draft-layer fallback and the global-scale branch keep their conventions, and out-of-range and negative ids raise.

Alternatives considered:

- Keep every local replica when narrowing. This fixes loading but changes dispatch: `dynamic` gets more candidates, and the static table draws its random picks in a different order.
- Change only dispatch, so that no rank picks an unloaded replica. After an online rebalance the lists are full again, and a slot that keeps the same expert is not copied (`update_expert_weights_single_layer` treats it as unchanged), so a never-written slot can still be picked.
- Copy the first local replica into the others after loading. That has to cover every load path and every parameter, including quantization scales.

## Accuracy Tests

**CPU repro** (script and full output below). EP2, 4 logical experts + 2 redundant, rank 1 holds both replicas of expert 3 (slots 3 and 4), rank 0 holds none.

- On main @ 78185f4b, rank 1 never writes slot 4. Rank 0's static table sends expert 3 to slot 4 in 1 of 8 layers, and with `dynamic`, 4047 of rank 0's 8000 tokens for expert 3 go there.
- With this PR, rank 1 writes slots 3, 4 and 5. Both ranks' static picks for expert 3 are the same as on main, layer by layer; this PR does not touch the dispatch tables.

**CPU tests**

- The new file: 8 passed, 42 subtests.
- Together with the existing `test/registered/unit/eplb/`, `test/registered/unit/model_loader/test_presharded_loader.py`, `test/registered/unit/model_loader/test_modelopt_loader.py` and `test/registered/unit/layers/quantization/test_moe_wna16_ep_shard.py`: 123 passed, 2 skipped (both need CUDA), 88 subtests passed.
- With the fix reverted in place (the old lookup, a filter that keeps every id, the old `moe_wna16` code), 6 of the 8 new tests fail. Each of these partial changes makes at least one new test fail:
  - reverting only the lookup;
  - making only the new filter keep every id;
  - reverting only the `moe_wna16` change;
  - filtering shared ids in `moe_wna16` too;
  - applying the filter to `require_global_experts` params too;
  - dropping the lower bound of the id check.
- Lint with the versions pinned in `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, plus `check_registered_tests`: clean.

**GPU.** We ran this change once, on an earlier `main`, with the two saved layouts; this was not a GPU run of 78185f4b itself. That tree also had the changes of #45341, which are inactive here because the weight cache is off.

- Model and flags: Qwen3-30B-A3B (BF16) with `--tp 2 --ep-size 2 --enable-eplb --ep-num-redundant-experts 2 --random-seed 42 --moe-a2a-backend deepep --deepep-mode normal --moe-runner-backend deep_gemm --deepep-dispatcher-output-dtype bf16 --max-running-requests 128 --mem-fraction-static 0.6 --disable-radix-cache --eplb-rebalance-num-iterations 1000000000 --expert-distribution-recorder-buffer-size 1000` (no rebalance during the test), plus `--init-expert-location` set to one of the two saved layouts above.
- Controls, in the same run: the same model, flags, saved layouts and disk-loading path, without this change. Their trees also had inactive weight-cache changes.
- After loading, we hashed every tensor on every rank, slot by slot for the expert tensors.
- A slot counts as an expert only if its hashes equal those of an expert in a server that used the default layout and never rebalanced.
- The reference is a server that routes with the same layout and whose 6240 expert slots all hold the expert the layout puts there. It received its weights through the weight cache from a server that had rebalanced into this layout (#45341).
- Greedy outputs: 8 fixed prompts x 32 tokens.

| | layout 1 | layout 2 |
|---|---|---|
| layers with two replicas of an expert on one rank (of 48) | 16 | 23 |
| slots that hold such a second replica (of 6240) | 19 | 27 |
| without this change: slots that hold no expert | 19, exactly those | 27, exactly those |
| without this change: expert slots equal to the reference | 6221 | 6213 |
| with this change: expert slots equal to the reference | 6240 | 6240 |
| greedy outputs equal to the reference, without / with this change | 7/8 / 8/8 | 5/8 / 8/8 |

All non-expert tensors were byte-identical to the reference on both ranks, in all four servers.

GSM8K (5-shot, all 1319 questions, 128 at a time) was recorded for context and was not a criterion. Correct answers: 1204 and 1210 without this change, 1205 and 1193 with it. Two passes of the never-rebalanced server on the same setup differed by 7 and by 9.

Not tested on GPU:
- quantized checkpoints (the `moe_wna16` path);
- elastic EP scale-up;
- `dynamic` dispatch;
- online rebalancing after startup, and weight updates after it;
- other models, EP > 2, more than one node;
- a repeat of this run.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not measured. Only weight loading changes: the lookup compares one row of `physical_to_logical_map` per call instead of indexing the per-rank list, and a rank that holds two replicas of an expert now writes that expert twice. Dispatch and forward passes are unchanged.

## Related

- #10874: the per-rank narrowing.
- The earlier fix for unloaded rows of global scale parameters: #12866, #13162, #13348 (reverted #13162 after loading hangs), #13484 (reintroduced it with a race fix).
- #32962: no narrowing without an a2a backend.
- Open #45282 and #37923 also edit `eplb/expert_location.py`, in other functions.
- deepseek-ai/EPLB#22: the algorithm can put duplicate replicas on one GPU. deepseek-ai/EPLB#27 and deepseek-ai/EPLB#28 try to avoid that where possible; layouts that already exist are not changed.
- Open #45322 adds an `elif` right before the `logical_to_all_physical()` call in `FusedMoE.weight_loader`. Whichever lands second may need a small rebase.
- Different from #39580 and #18213, which are about wrong output after rebalancing without an a2a backend.

"""CPU-only repro: with an a2a backend (e.g. --moe-a2a-backend deepep) and an
--init-expert-location physical_to_logical_map that puts two replicas of one
logical expert on the same EP rank, the second replica is never loaded, while
another rank's static dispatch table can still route tokens to it.

It calls the real SGLang code; no GPU, model or server is needed:
  compute_initial_expert_location_metadata    what each rank builds from --init-expert-location
  ExpertLocationMetadata.logical_to_all_physical  the slots FusedMoE.weight_loader writes
  topk_ids_logical_to_physical                the physical slot a token is dispatched to

Usage: PYTHONPATH=<sglang checkout>/python python repro_same_rank_replica.py [--layers N]
Exit code: 1 if a rank dispatches to a slot its owner never loads, else 0.
"""

import argparse
import json
import sys
from unittest import mock

import torch

from sglang.srt.eplb import expert_location as el
from sglang.srt.eplb.expert_location_dispatch import (
    ExpertLocationDispatchInfo,
    topk_ids_logical_to_physical,
)
from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context

EP_SIZE = 2
NUM_LOGICAL = 4
NUM_REDUNDANT = 2
NUM_PHYSICAL = NUM_LOGICAL + NUM_REDUNDANT  # 6 slots: rank 0 = 0..2, rank 1 = 3..5
SLOTS_PER_RANK = NUM_PHYSICAL // EP_SIZE
NUM_LAYERS = 8  # --layers
HOT = 3
# Same row in every layer: logical expert 3 has two replicas, both on rank 1
# (slots 3 and 4); rank 0 has no replica of it.
ROW = [0, 1, 2, 3, 3, 0]


def owner(slot):
    return slot // SLOTS_PER_RANK


def build_rank(rank, a2a_backend, dispatch_algorithm, num_tokens=1):
    """Return what one EP rank loads and where it dispatches, per layer."""
    shape = el.ModelConfigForExpertLocation(
        num_layers=NUM_LAYERS, num_logical_experts=NUM_LOGICAL
    )
    overrides = dict(
        device="cpu",
        ep_size=EP_SIZE,
        nnodes=1,
        moe_a2a_backend=a2a_backend,
        ep_dispatch_algorithm=dispatch_algorithm,
        ep_num_redundant_experts=NUM_REDUNDANT,
        init_expert_location=json.dumps(
            {"physical_to_logical_map": [ROW] * NUM_LAYERS}
        ),
    )
    # No model is loaded, so only the layer / expert counts come from the patch.
    with get_context().override_server_args(**overrides), mock.patch.object(
        el.ModelConfigForExpertLocation,
        "from_model_config",
        staticmethod(lambda model_config: shape),
    ):
        # ModelRunner.maybe_init_expert_location_metadata does this on every rank
        # before load_model(). With static dispatch it also builds this rank's
        # logical_to_rank_dispatch_physical_map (a seeded random pick, seed 42).
        metadata = el.compute_initial_expert_location_metadata(
            model_config=None, moe_ep_rank=rank
        )
        el.set_global_expert_location_metadata(metadata, allow_overwrite=True)
        loaded, dispatch = [], []
        for layer in range(NUM_LAYERS):
            # FusedMoE.weight_loader: for checkpoint expert e, write every slot in
            # logical_to_all_physical(layer, e) that lives on this rank.
            loaded.append(
                sorted(
                    slot
                    for e in range(NUM_LOGICAL)
                    for slot in metadata.logical_to_all_physical(layer, e)
                    if owner(slot) == rank
                )
            )
            info = ExpertLocationDispatchInfo.init_new(layer_id=layer)
            topk_ids = torch.full((num_tokens, 1), HOT, dtype=torch.int64)
            dispatch.append(topk_ids_logical_to_physical(topk_ids, info).view(-1))
        candidates = metadata.logical_to_all_physical(0, HOT)
    return loaded, dispatch, candidates


def run(a2a_backend, dispatch_algorithm, num_tokens=1):
    ranks = [
        build_rank(r, a2a_backend, dispatch_algorithm, num_tokens)
        for r in range(EP_SIZE)
    ]
    print(
        f"\n== --moe-a2a-backend {a2a_backend} "
        f"--ep-dispatch-algorithm {dispatch_algorithm} =="
    )
    for r, (loaded, _, candidates) in enumerate(ranks):
        never = sorted(
            set(range(r * SLOTS_PER_RANK, (r + 1) * SLOTS_PER_RANK)) - set(loaded[0])
        )
        print(
            f"rank {r}: weight loader writes slots {loaded[0]}, never writes {never}; "
            f"logical_to_all_physical(layer, {HOT}) = {candidates}"
        )
    bad_layers = set()
    for r, (_, dispatch, _) in enumerate(ranks):
        hits = {}  # layer -> tokens sent to a slot its owner never loaded
        for layer, slots in enumerate(dispatch):
            missing = [
                int(s) for s in slots if int(s) not in ranks[owner(int(s))][0][layer]
            ]
            if missing:
                hits[layer] = missing
        bad_layers |= set(hits)
        slots_hit = sorted({s for m in hits.values() for s in m})
        if num_tokens == 1:
            picks = [int(d[0]) for d in dispatch]
            print(
                f"rank {r}: logical {HOT} is dispatched to slot, per layer: {picks}"
                + (
                    f"\n        -> never-loaded slot {slots_hit} in layers {sorted(hits)}"
                    if hits
                    else ""
                )
            )
        else:
            n = sum(len(m) for m in hits.values())
            print(
                f"rank {r}: {n}/{num_tokens * NUM_LAYERS} tokens of logical {HOT} go to "
                f"never-loaded slot(s) {slots_hit} ({len(hits)}/{NUM_LAYERS} layers)"
            )
    return len(bad_layers)


def main():
    global NUM_LAYERS
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    parser.add_argument("--layers", type=int, default=NUM_LAYERS)
    NUM_LAYERS = parser.parse_args().layers
    print(
        f"EP size {EP_SIZE}, {NUM_LOGICAL} logical experts + {NUM_REDUNDANT} redundant = "
        f"{NUM_PHYSICAL} slots ({SLOTS_PER_RANK} per rank), {NUM_LAYERS} layers"
    )
    print(
        f"--init-expert-location row in every layer: rank 0 slots 0-2 = {ROW[:3]}, "
        f"rank 1 slots 3-5 = {ROW[3:]}"
    )
    bad_static = run("deepep", "static")
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    bad_dynamic = run("deepep", "dynamic", num_tokens=1000)
    bad_control = run("none", "dynamic", num_tokens=1000)
    print()
    print(f"layers that route to a never-loaded slot (of {NUM_LAYERS}):")
    print(f"  deepep + static (default with an a2a backend): {bad_static}")
    print(f"  deepep + dynamic: {bad_dynamic}")
    print(f"  control, no a2a backend: {bad_control}")
    reproduced = bad_static > 0 or bad_dynamic > 0
    print("RESULT:", "REPRODUCED" if reproduced else "NOT_REPRODUCED")
    return 1 if reproduced else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

+"""Which physical slots the MoE weight loaders fill; no server, no model loading."""
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=12, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+import contextlib
+import random
+import types
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.eplb.expert_location import (
+    ExpertLocationMetadata,
+    _compute_logical_to_all_physical_map,
+    get_global_expert_location_metadata,
+    set_global_expert_location_metadata,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.fused_moe_triton.layer import FusedMoE
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization import moe_wna16
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+# EP 2, 4 logical experts + 2 redundant: rank 0 holds slots 0-2, rank 1 slots 3-5.
+# Logical expert 3 has both of its replicas on rank 1; rank 0 has none.
+SAME_RANK_REPLICAS = [[0, 1, 2, 3, 3, 0]] * 3
+
+# EP 4 on 2 nodes, 2 slots per rank. Expert 0 has two replicas on rank 0 and one on
+# rank 2, so rank 1 (no replica, node 0) narrows to a same-node replica.
+SAME_NODE_NARROWING = [[0, 0, 1, 2, 3, 0, 1, 3]] * 2
+
+
+def _metadata(
+    layout,
+    *,
+    ep_size,
+    nnodes,
+    moe_ep_rank,
+    moe_a2a_backend="deepep",
+    ep_join_mode=None,
+):
+    """What ExpertLocationMetadata.init_by_mapping builds on one EP rank."""
+    physical_to_logical_map = torch.tensor(layout)
+    num_logical_experts = int(physical_to_logical_map.max()) + 1
+    with get_context().override_server_args(
+        ep_size=ep_size,
+        nnodes=nnodes,
+        moe_a2a_backend=moe_a2a_backend,
+        ep_join_mode=ep_join_mode,
+        ep_dispatch_algorithm="static" if moe_a2a_backend != "none" else "dynamic",
+    ):
+        logical_to_all_physical_map = _compute_logical_to_all_physical_map(
+            physical_to_logical_map=physical_to_logical_map,
+            num_logical_experts=num_logical_experts,
+            ep_size=ep_size,
+            moe_ep_rank=moe_ep_rank,
+        )
+        return ExpertLocationMetadata._init_raw(
+            ep_size=ep_size,
+            physical_to_logical_map=physical_to_logical_map,
+            logical_to_all_physical_map=logical_to_all_physical_map,
+            moe_ep_rank=moe_ep_rank,
+        )
+
+
+def _random_layout(rng, num_layers, num_logical_experts, num_physical_experts):
+    """Every logical expert at least once, the remaining slots random replicas."""
+    layout = []
+    for _ in range(num_layers):
+        row = list(range(num_logical_experts)) + [
+            rng.randrange(num_logical_experts)
+            for _ in range(num_physical_experts - num_logical_experts)
+        ]
+        rng.shuffle(row)
+        layout.append(row)
+    return layout
+
+
+def _stand_in_layer(
+    *,
+    layer_id,
+    ep_size,
+    rank,
+    num_local_routed,
+    num_global_routed,
+    num_shared=0,
+):
+    """The FusedMoE fields and methods that the expert weight loaders read."""
+    layer = types.SimpleNamespace(
+        quant_config=None,
+        quant_method=None,
+        uses_expert_location=True,
+        layer_id=layer_id,
+        moe_ep_size=ep_size,
+        num_local_experts=num_local_routed + num_shared,
+        num_fused_shared_experts=num_shared,
+        _has_fused_shared=num_shared > 0,
+        _expert_storage_rank=rank,
+        _num_local_routed=num_local_routed,
+        _num_global_routed=num_global_routed,
+    )
+    for name in (
+        "_map_global_expert_id_to_local_expert_id",
+        "_local_routed_expert_ids",
+        "_weight_loader_physical",
+    ):
+        setattr(layer, name, types.MethodType(getattr(FusedMoE, name), layer))
+    return layer
+
+
+@contextlib.contextmanager
+def _published(metadata):
+    previous = get_global_expert_location_metadata()
+    set_global_expert_location_metadata(metadata, allow_overwrite=True)
+    try:
+        yield
+    finally:
+        set_global_expert_location_metadata(previous, allow_overwrite=True)
+
+
+def _load_with_fused_moe(
+    metadata,
+    *,
+    layer_id,
+    rank,
+    num_local_routed,
+    num_global_routed,
+    num_shared=0,
+    require_global_experts=False,
+):
+    """Run FusedMoE.weight_loader for every checkpoint expert on a stand-in layer and
+    return {slot: checkpoint expert written there}; global slots for a global param."""
+    layer = _stand_in_layer(
+        layer_id=layer_id,
+        ep_size=metadata.ep_size,
+        rank=rank,
+        num_local_routed=num_local_routed,
+        num_global_routed=num_global_routed,
+        num_shared=num_shared,
+    )
+    written = {}
+
+    def _weight_loader_impl(*, param, loaded_weight, weight_name, shard_id, expert_id):
+        written[expert_id] = int(loaded_weight)
+
+    layer._weight_loader_impl = _weight_loader_impl
+    param = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(0), requires_grad=False)
+    if require_global_experts:
+        param._sglang_require_global_experts = True
+    # Shared experts first, so that a routed expert written over a shared slot shows.
+    checkpoint_experts = [
+        metadata.num_logical_experts + i for i in range(num_shared)
+    ] + list(range(metadata.num_logical_experts))
+    with _published(metadata):
+        for expert_id in checkpoint_experts:
+            FusedMoE.weight_loader(
+                layer, param, torch.tensor(expert_id), "w13_weight", "w1", expert_id
+            )
+    return written
+
+
+def _scale_up_layout(num_logical, per_rank):
+    """EP 2 -> 4 scale-up: the new ranks' slots repeat experts 0..num_logical-1."""
+    return [list(range(num_logical)) + [i % num_logical for i in range(2 * per_rank)]]
+
+
+class TestExpertLocationWeightLoading(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_lookup_returns_exactly_the_slots_of_each_expert(self):
+        rng = random.Random(0)
+        cases = [
+            ("same_rank_replicas", SAME_RANK_REPLICAS, 2, 1),
+            ("same_node_narrowing", SAME_NODE_NARROWING, 4, 2),
+            ("random_ep4", _random_layout(rng, 4, 8, 16), 4, 1),
+        ]
+        for name, layout, ep_size, nnodes in cases:
+            for moe_a2a_backend in ["deepep", "none"]:
+                for rank in range(ep_size):
+                    with self.subTest(name, backend=moe_a2a_backend, rank=rank):
+                        metadata = _metadata(
+                            layout,
+                            ep_size=ep_size,
+                            nnodes=nnodes,
+                            moe_ep_rank=rank,
+                            moe_a2a_backend=moe_a2a_backend,
+                        )
+                        for layer_id, row in enumerate(layout):
+                            for logical_expert_id in range(
+                                metadata.num_logical_experts
+                            ):
+                                self.assertEqual(
+                                    metadata.logical_to_all_physical(
+                                        layer_id, logical_expert_id
+                                    ),
+                                    [
+                                        slot
+                                        for slot, expert in enumerate(row)
+                                        if expert == logical_expert_id
+                                    ],
+                                )
+
+    def test_loader_fills_every_local_slot_with_its_expert(self):
+        """Every slot a rank stores gets the expert the layout puts there,
+        including a second replica of an expert on the same rank."""
+        rng = random.Random(1)
+        cases = [
+            ("same_rank_replicas", SAME_RANK_REPLICAS, 2, 1),
+            ("same_node_narrowing", SAME_NODE_NARROWING, 4, 2),
+            ("random_ep2", _random_layout(rng, 3, 8, 16), 2, 1),
+            ("random_ep4_2nodes", _random_layout(rng, 3, 8, 16), 4, 2),
+        ]
+        for name, layout, ep_size, nnodes in cases:
+            per_rank = len(layout[0]) // ep_size
+            for rank in range(ep_size):
+                with self.subTest(name, rank=rank):
+                    metadata = _metadata(
+                        layout, ep_size=ep_size, nnodes=nnodes, moe_ep_rank=rank
+                    )
+                    for layer_id, row in enumerate(layout):
+                        written = _load_with_fused_moe(
+                            metadata,
+                            layer_id=layer_id,
+                            rank=rank,
+                            num_local_routed=per_rank,
+                            num_global_routed=len(row),
+                        )
+                        own = row[rank * per_rank : (rank + 1) * per_rank]
+                        self.assertEqual(written, dict(enumerate(own)))
+
+    def test_static_dispatch_only_targets_loaded_slots(self):
+        """No rank's static dispatch table sends an expert's tokens to a slot that
+        its owner left unloaded or loaded with another expert."""
+        all_metadata = [
+            _metadata(SAME_RANK_REPLICAS, ep_size=2, nnodes=1, moe_ep_rank=rank)
+            for rank in range(2)
+        ]
+        per_rank = all_metadata[0].num_local_physical_experts
+        for rank, metadata in enumerate(all_metadata):
+            table = metadata.logical_to_rank_dispatch_physical_map.tolist()
+            for layer_id, row in enumerate(table):
+                for logical_expert_id, slot in enumerate(row):
+                    owner = slot // per_rank
+                    written = _load_with_fused_moe(
+                        all_metadata[owner],
+                        layer_id=layer_id,
+                        rank=owner,
+                        num_local_routed=per_rank,
+                        num_global_routed=per_rank * 2,
+                    )
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        written.get(slot - owner * per_rank),
+                        logical_expert_id,
+                        f"{rank=} {layer_id=} {logical_expert_id=}",
+                    )
+
+    def test_scale_up_keeps_fused_shared_slots(self):
+        """After an EP 2 -> 4 scale-up, loading routed experts on a starting rank
+        leaves its fused shared slot to the shared expert."""
+        # The new ranks' slots 256-511 lie past the starting ranks' _num_global_routed.
+        num_logical, per_rank = 256, 128
+        layout = _scale_up_layout(num_logical, per_rank)
+        for rank in range(2):
+            with self.subTest(rank=rank):
+                metadata = _metadata(
+                    layout,
+                    ep_size=4,
+                    nnodes=1,
+                    moe_ep_rank=rank,
+                    ep_join_mode="scale",
+                )
+                written = _load_with_fused_moe(
+                    metadata,
+                    layer_id=0,
+                    rank=rank,
+                    num_local_routed=per_rank,
+                    num_global_routed=num_logical,
+                    num_shared=1,
+                )
+                expected = dict(
+                    enumerate(layout[0][rank * per_rank : (rank + 1) * per_rank])
+                )
+                expected[per_rank] = num_logical  # the shared expert's checkpoint id
+                self.assertEqual(written, expected)
+
+    def test_global_params_skip_the_local_filter(self):
+        """A param with _sglang_require_global_experts (global input scales) still
+        gets every slot of every expert, on every rank."""
+        for rank in range(2):
+            with self.subTest(rank=rank):
+                metadata = _metadata(
+                    SAME_RANK_REPLICAS, ep_size=2, nnodes=1, moe_ep_rank=rank
+                )
+                written = _load_with_fused_moe(
+                    metadata,
+                    layer_id=0,
+                    rank=rank,
+                    num_local_routed=3,
+                    num_global_routed=6,
+                    require_global_experts=True,
+                )
+                # Global params use slots e, e + 4, ... below the 6 physical slots.
+                self.assertEqual(written, {0: 0, 4: 0, 1: 1, 5: 1, 2: 2, 3: 3})
+
+    def test_wna16_qzeros_use_the_same_slots(self):
+        # moe_wna16 writes qzeros outside the layer's loader, so it picks the
+        # slots itself and must agree with the loader.
+        scale_up = _scale_up_layout(256, 128)
+        cases = [
+            # name, layout, ep_size, ep_join_mode, rank, layer_id,
+            # (local routed slots, global routed slots at startup),
+            # fused shared experts, checkpoint expert, expected local slots
+            ("second_replica", SAME_RANK_REPLICAS, 2, None, 1, 0, (3, 6), 0, 3, [0, 1]),
+            ("scale_up_rank0", scale_up, 4, "scale", 0, 0, (128, 256), 1, 0, [0]),
+            ("scale_up_rank1", scale_up, 4, "scale", 1, 0, (128, 256), 1, 0, []),
+            # A draft layer past the expert map keeps the fused shared expert.
+            ("draft_shared", [[0, 1, 2, 3]] * 3, 1, None, 0, 3, (4, 4), 1, 4, [4]),
+        ]
+        for (
+            name,
+            layout,
+            ep_size,
+            ep_join_mode,
+            rank,
+            layer_id,
+            (num_local_routed, num_global_routed),
+            num_shared,
+            expert_id,
+            expected,
+        ) in cases:
+            with self.subTest(name):
+                metadata = _metadata(
+                    layout,
+                    ep_size=ep_size,
+                    nnodes=1,
+                    moe_ep_rank=rank,
+                    ep_join_mode=ep_join_mode,
+                )
+                layer = _stand_in_layer(
+                    layer_id=layer_id,
+                    ep_size=ep_size,
+                    rank=rank,
+                    num_local_routed=num_local_routed,
+                    num_global_routed=num_global_routed,
+                    num_shared=num_shared,
+                )
+                with _published(metadata):
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        moe_wna16._local_expert_ids(layer, expert_id), expected

+
+    def test_dispatch_candidates_are_unchanged(self):

+        metadata = _metadata(SAME_RANK_REPLICAS, ep_size=2, nnodes=1, moe_ep_rank=1)
+        self.assertEqual(int(metadata.logical_to_all_physical_map_num_valid[0, 3]), 1)

+    def test_fallbacks_and_bounds(self):
